description: Epoch AI 'training-cost-trends' github repo data — ML systems full view, chip dataset, hardware prices, and model cost estimates.

body.how_to_read: Inputs behind Epoch's training-cost-trends analysis: a chip dataset (5775 rows), a hardware-price time series, a producer-price index (PCU), and model cost estimates. 'Hardware prices.csv' is useful for accelerator price trends. Read each CSV header for columns.

methodology.summary: Data CSVs from the epoch-research/training-cost-trends repo, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12 (CSV-only). Confidence 0.8 (CC BY 4.0).
